title: valeriana pipenbergica
intro: Valeriana pipenbergica, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae, is a type of valerian. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana pipenbergica include its sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic properties, which contribute to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valepotriates, isovaleramide, and valerenic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
